title: Resume-path defect fix: rotation-ceiling + cwd enforcement seam on every worker launch/resume path
objective: Close the COMPLETE resume-path defect class per D-024 Amendment 19 (rows R331..R344): every path capable of launching or resuming a Claude worker (ordinary start, recovery start, controller restart, rotation, turnover, checkpoint continuation) evaluates the context-rotation ceiling BEFORE provider contact; a session at or above the 400k ceiling is NEVER resumed - it rotates to a fresh session at the safe seam or fails closed pre-provider; every launch/resume/rotation binds cwd to the task packet's isolated worktree and fails closed on a primary-checkout or unexpected cwd; rotation preserves checkpoint lineage, task identity, budgets, audit history, branch, worktree, and exactly-once succession; the old oversized transcript receives no new events and the new session has a distinct identity starting in wt-m0t107. Enumerate every launch/resume call site with a same-seam proof + a deterministic bypass-sensitive reachability test (R339/R340). Use the preserved cycle-2 journal and transcript as READ-ONLY regression fixtures (R341); cover the 12-item matrix (R342). Record the rc=1/missing-result terminal evidence honestly; a provider context-limit rejection stays an inference unless recovered from primary evidence (R343/R344). QUALIFYING EVIDENCE (supervisor-freeze S2/S3): reproduced live defect - cycle-2 start resumed the 604,772-token session to context_tokens 640,224 with no rotation and cwd on the primary checkout, rc=1, S14 no_valid_checkpoint (project-control/reports/M0-T107-cycle2-live-journey.md); authorized by D-024-R330. PROHIBITIONS: R345 (no live-loop restart, no clear-recovery, no journal edit, no budget reset, no PR #241) + R328 (the S16.7 disposition grants nothing). Fix invalidates the fourth certification -> fifth R247 recert = M0-T124.
business_reason: The live loop cannot complete a context-rotation crossing: the resume path bypasses the rotation ceiling and worktree binding, so every long-running unit will eventually die exactly as cycle 2 did. This is the last defect standing between the certified system and a completable live journey.

acceptance_scenarios.scenario: REPRODUCED DEFECT RED: a journal/fixture in the live cycle-2 shape (recorded provider session with telemetry at/above 400k) driven through the pre-fix resume path reaches provider contact without rotation; the SAME shape on the fixed tree refuses or rotates BEFORE provider contact.
acceptance_scenarios.verification: red/green pair on the enforcement seam; the red reproduced against the pre-fix logic

acceptance_scenarios.scenario: Ceiling matrix: at 400k exactly and above -> never resumed (rotate or fail closed pre-provider); below 400k -> resume permitted; missing/unknown telemetry -> fail closed (never assumed below).
acceptance_scenarios.verification: named tests per band incl. the exact-threshold boundary

acceptance_scenarios.scenario: cwd binding: launch/resume/rotation with cwd == the packet's isolated worktree proceeds; primary-checkout cwd or any unexpected cwd fails closed BEFORE provider contact with a typed refusal.
acceptance_scenarios.verification: named tests incl. Windows path forms (drive case, slashes)

acceptance_scenarios.scenario: Rotation preservation: rotating at the seam carries checkpoint lineage, task identity, budgets, audit chain, branch, worktree; succession is exactly-once (no duplicate or lost unit); the old transcript/session receives no further events; the new session identity is distinct and starts in the packet worktree.
acceptance_scenarios.verification: rotation tests asserting each preserved property + transcript-freeze + distinct-identity

acceptance_scenarios.scenario: Call-site closure: the reachability sweep mechanically enumerates every worker-launch/resume call site and FAILS if any site bypasses the rotation guard or the cwd guard; removing the guard wiring from any one site turns the sweep RED.
acceptance_scenarios.verification: bypass-sensitive reachability test + per-site removal sensitivity

acceptance_scenarios.scenario: Lifecycle coverage: recovery start, controller restart (owner-restart then start), turnover, and checkpoint continuation all route through the same seam; concurrent controllers cannot double-launch (single-instance lock); stale session identities are surfaced, never silently adopted; a provider failure during launch is a typed refusal, not a crash.

Fixtures: committed regression fixtures are derived from the PRESERVED cycle-2 journal/transcript read-only (originals byte-unchanged after the derivation - hashes recorded before/after), and the fixture-driven tests reproduce the defect shape.
acceptance_scenarios.verification: fixture derivation script/output + before/after hashes in the producer report

acceptance_scenarios.scenario: Terminal-evidence honesty: the producer report records rc=1 + no result record verbatim; if the actual terminal event (stderr/API error) is recoverable from primary evidence it is quoted with provenance, otherwise the context-limit explanation is explicitly labeled an unproven inference.
acceptance_scenarios.verification: producer report section reviewed against R343/R344
